name: Spark
description: A crackling bolt of arcane energy strikes the nearest foe ahead of you.

name: Heal Minor Wounds
description: Mend your wounds with a whispered word. Restores 20% of your max HP, or 8, whichever is more.

name: Stone Skin
description: Your skin hardens like granite for a short while. +4 Defense for 12 turns.

name: Firebolt
description: A roaring gout of flame lances out ahead of you.

name: Blink
description: Fold space and step through the wind itself.

name: Detect Monsters
description: Sense every living foe in this chamber, even those hidden in shadow.

name: Detect Treasure
description: Sense loose valuables and sealed chests hidden in shadow.

name: Neutralize Poison
description: Purge every trace of venom from your blood, ending its damage before it runs its course.

name: Word of Recall
description: Speak the word that binds you to town. Cast away from town, it marks your spot and pulls you home; cast again in town, it pulls you right back.

name: Identify
description: A moment of insight lays bare an unproven find's true nature -- enchantment, curse, or lack of either.

name: Remove Curse
description: A cleansing word breaks a curse's grip, freeing whatever it binds to be worn or set aside at will.

name: Detect Traps
description: Sense the hidden mechanisms of dart, pit, and gas traps lurking in this chamber.

name: Levitation
description: Rise a hand's breadth off the floor, drifting harmlessly over dart, pit, and gas traps for a time.

name: Cold Bolt
description: A lance of biting frost streaks out ahead of you, chilling flesh to the bone.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: An electrical discharge arcs out ahead of you, crackling toward your foe.

name: Resist Fire
description: Ward your flesh against flame. Halves fire damage you take for a time.

name: Resist Cold
description: Ward your flesh against frost. Halves cold damage you take for a time.

name: Resist Lightning
description: Ward your flesh against the storm. Halves lightning damage you take for a time.

name: Heal Medium Wounds
description: A steadier working of the healing word. Restores 40% of your max HP, or 16, whichever is more.

name: Heal Major Wounds
description: The deepest healing word you know, knitting flesh and bone alike. Restores 60% of your max HP, or 24, whichever is more.

name: Light
description: A word of power floods this room with radiance, burning away every shadow at once.

name: Clairvoyance
description: Your mind's eye ranges out across the nearby passages, filling in the map of this stretch of the dungeon without a step taken.

name: Sleep Monster
description: A whispered word of power sends a single foe ahead of you into an unnatural slumber, defenseless until struck or roused. Some monsters resist it outright.

name: Fireball
description: A roaring gout of flame erupts in a blazing sphere, engulfing your foe and all who stand beside it.

name: Cold Ball
description: A lance of frost blooms into a sphere of killing cold, biting deep into your foe and all who stand beside it.

name: Ball Lightning
description: A crackling orb of raw current bursts outward, arcing through your foe and all who stand beside it.

name: Slow Monster
description: A muttered curse leadens your foe's limbs, halving its speed to a crawl. Cast it again on the same target and the burden doubles further.
